hooks.command: bash -c 'NAME=$(cat | jq -r .name); DIR="/tmp/claude-worktrees/$NAME"; mkdir -p /tmp/claude-worktrees && git worktree add "$DIR" -b "worktree-$NAME" >&2 && echo "$DIR"'
bash -c 'WTPATH=$(cat | jq -r .worktree_path); git worktree remove "$WTPATH" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$WTPATH" 2>/dev/null; exit 0'
